Rules

Welcome to Tirbix!

Walk with W A S D and jump with Space. Bricks are 1.2 studs tall, so you have to jump onto them. If you fall off the world you come back at the spawn.

Change your character's colors in the Catalog on the website, and build your own games in Tirbix Creators. Open Settings for graphics, camera, cursor and sound.

W A S D / ArrowsWalk (relative to the camera)
SpaceJump. Hold it to keep jumping
Right mouse buttonHold and drag to turn the camera
ShiftShift Lock on / off (can be turned off in Settings)
Mouse wheel / I, OZoom in / out. Zoom all the way in for first person
< > (comma, period)Rotate the camera 45°
Page Up / Page DownTilt the camera
/Chat (guests: Quick Chat)
Enter / EscSend / cancel a chat message
  1. Be nice to everyone. No bullying, threats or hate.
  2. No swearing. Bad words are replaced with ####.
  3. Never share personal information: your real name, address, phone number, school or passwords.
  4. No cheating, hacking or abusing bugs.
  5. Do not pretend to be another player or the Tirbix team.
  6. Guests can only use Quick Chat. Sign up to type your own messages.
  7. Have fun and build cool stuff!

Tirbix Creators
Tirbix Creators Help

Press one of the three green + buttons to add a grey block, ball or cylinder where the camera looks (the + key adds a block). In Properties on the right you change its color, Material (Plastic with studs, Smooth, Wood, Brick, Stone, Grass, Metal, Sand, Ice, Fabric, Neon), shape, size and position, or upload your own Picture for it.

1  SelectClick a brick to select it. Drag it to slide it on top of other bricks
2  MoveDrag the orange arrows
3  RotateDrag the green ring. R turns the brick 90°
4  ResizeDrag the blue balls
Right mouseHold and drag to look around
W A S D, Q EFly the camera. Hold Shift to fly slowly
Mouse wheelFly forward / back towards the mouse
Middle mouseSlide the camera
+Add a brick
FLook at the selected brick
Ctrl+D / DeleteDuplicate / delete the selected brick
Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+YUndo / redo
Ctrl+SSave
F5Play test. Press Leave in the game to come back

The SpawnLocation (the brick with the flag in the Explorer) is where players appear. Tick Spawn in Properties to make any brick a spawn. The Baseplate is locked so you do not move it by accident: select it in the Explorer and untick Locked to change it. A game can have up to 500 bricks.

Tirbix Terms of Use

Welcome to Tirbix! By making an account or playing as a guest you agree to these rules. They keep Tirbix fun and safe for everyone.

1. Be nice

Treat other players with respect. Bullying, threats, harassment and hate of any kind are not allowed.

2. Keep chat and the forum clean

No swearing, rude or scary messages. Bad words are filtered and replaced with ####. Do not spam.

3. Stay safe

Never share personal information: your real name, address, phone number, school, photos or passwords. Nobody from Tirbix will ever ask for your password.

4. Play fair

No cheating, hacking, exploiting bugs or using programs that change the game.

5. Be yourself

Do not pretend to be another player or the Tirbix team. Usernames must not be rude or contain personal information.

6. Guests

Guests can only talk with Quick Chat and cannot post on the forum. Sign up for free to type your own messages and keep your name.

7. Your account

Right now accounts and forum posts are saved only in this browser on this device. If you clear your browser data or forget your password, the account cannot be recovered. Choose a password you do not use anywhere else.

8. Changes

These rules may change as Tirbix grows.
